query: 本地离线中文语音转文字（带时间戳）开源方案，CPU 即可运行，数据不外传，最好还能生成会议纪要

mustHaveCapabilities: 本地离线中文语音转文字并输出时间戳
fingerprint.desiredOutcome: 在纯 CPU 的 Windows 电脑上，把中文录音/会议音频离线转成带时间戳的文字稿，并尽量自动整理会议纪要
fingerprint.operatingMode: 本地桌面应用或本地命令行/脚本，纯 CPU，Windows

payload.title: FunASR
payload.snippet: FunASR: A Fundamental End-to-End Speech Recognition Toolkit. Paraformer-zh large offline ASR with timestamps; SenseVoiceSmall CPU-viable (~17x realtime) multilingual; fsmn-vad + ct-punc + cam++ speaker diarization; pip install funasr; Fun-ASR-Nano needs device=cuda (GPU).

payload.title: SmartSub / 妙幕
payload.snippet: Electron desktop app, Windows x64 installer. Local engines: FunASR, whisper.cpp, sherpa-onnx. 本地处理，文件不出本机. GPU accel with CPU fallback. AI subtitle refinement. MIT.

payload.title: FunClip
payload.snippet: Gradio web UI. Paraformer-Large with integrated timestamps. SRT output. Speaker diarization. LLM-assisted clipping. pip install -r requirements.txt. Runs on CPU.

payload.title: AudioNotes
payload.snippet: Local FunASR + Ollama. Docker (12GB+ RAM). Default ASR FunAudioLLM/Fun-ASR-Nano-2512 (GPU) + qwen3.5:2b. ASR_MODEL switchable to CPU models. Meeting/notes/Q&A use case. Generates notes via local LLM.

payload.title: sherpa-onnx
payload.snippet: Next-gen Kaldi + onnxruntime. Offline, Windows, CPU. Speaker diarization + VAD + ASR. Zipformer/Paraformer/Whisper models. C++/Python/CLI. 14471 stars. Apache-2.0.

payload.title: whisper.cpp
payload.snippet: C/C++ port of Whisper. Pure CPU, no GPU needed. Timestamps + SRT. Chinese weaker than Paraformer/SenseVoice. MIT.

payload.title: Buzz
payload.snippet: Whisper-based desktop GUI for Windows/Mac/Linux. Live + file transcription. Offline with local Whisper. Chinese accuracy limited by Whisper.

payload.title: meeting-minutes offline local search
payload.snippet: Returned: Tingji (听记), meeting-transcriber, jkinco-listen-open — local/offline meeting transcription + minutes bundles.

payload.title: DuckDuckGo: 本地离线中文语音转文字 开源
payload.snippet: FunASR, SenseVoice, Paraformer, whisper.cpp, sherpa-onnx, SmartSub/妙幕 appear as leading local/offline Chinese ASR options; cloud services (讯飞/通义听悟) require upload.
